title: ClanCraft Tjifty
description: ClanCraft is a Minecraft mod that lets players create clans, claim land shown on Xaero's World Map in clan colors, use server-synced waypoints, and manage an admin panel directly from the map.
body:
# **ClanCraft**
ClanCraft is a comprehensive Minecraft Fabric mod that seamlessly integrates chunk-based land claiming, clan management, waypoints, ranks, and custom nickname features directly into Xaero's World Map.

## **🌟 Key Features**
**- Clan & Nation Management:** Create and manage clans/guilds with customizable names and colors.
**- Visual Chunk Claiming:** Claim and unclaim chunks directly inside Xaero's World Map. Claimed areas are dynamically color-coded with your clan's color and display the clan's name.
**- Territory Protection:** Protect your clan lands from unauthorized block breaking, block placing, entity attacks, and chest/inventory access.
**- Flexible Claims Settings:** Toggle specific settings per clan like PvP status, chest access for outsiders, or temporarily disabling protection.
**- Waypoints:** Create, list, and manage private waypoints that anchor securely to their in-game coordinates on the world map.
**- Custom Ranks System:** Distinguish permissions and custom claim limits between ranks (Player, King, Admin).
**- Integrated Admin Tools:** Toggle "Admin Duty" directly from the map screen to modify claims, teleport by clicking the map, adjust default/player claim limits, and manage nicknames.
**- Language Selection:** Automatic multi-language selection prompt (English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish) on first connection.

## **🛠️ Installation Guide**
> _IMPORTANT_
>
> ClanCraft supports **multiple Minecraft versions**. Simply download the ClanCraft build that matches your Minecraft version, together with the corresponding versions of **Fabric Loader**, **Fabric API**, and **Xaero's World Map**. Players must have this mod installed on **both the client and server**.

# **1. Download Dependencies**
To run this mod, download the versions of **Fabric API** and **Xaero's World Map** that match your Minecraft version.

# **2. Installation Steps**
1. Download and install the matching **Fabric Loader** for your Minecraft version.
2. Place the following `.jar` files in your `.minecraft/mods` folder:
- ClanCraft
- Xaero's World Map
- Fabric API
3. Launch the game.

## **📢 Need a different Minecraft version?**
If you want to use ClanCraft on a different version of Minecraft, join the official Discord server to get help and custom builds: 👉 [Join Discord Server](https://discord.gg/YCQCDJMvFZ)

## **⌨️ Controls & Keybinds**
- **Open World Map:** Press **M** (default Xaero keybind).
- **Map Context Menu:** **Right-click** anywhere on the map to open the ClanCraft context menu. From here you can:
> Start/Stop claiming mode.  
> Right-click on claimed chunks to unclaim them.  
> Create a new waypoint at the clicked block.  
> Access the Admin Settings Panel (if in Admin Duty).

## **💬 Chat Commands**
### **👥 Clan Commands**
- /clan create <name> <color> - Create a new clan. Available colors: red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light_blue, blue, purple, magenta, pink, white.
- /clan invite <player> - Invite a player to your clan (requires Owner or Admin rank).
- /clan accept - Accept a pending invite.
- /clan deny - Deny a pending invite.
- /clan leave - Leave your current clan (owners cannot leave; use delete).
- /clan kick <player> - Kick a member from your clan (requires Owner or Admin rank).
- /clan info [name] - Display information about your clan or the specified clan.
- /clan list - List all clans registered on the server.
- /clan delete - Delete your clan and remove all its claims.

### **🗺️ Claim Commands**
- /claims - Display your clan's claim count and maximum limit.

### **📍 Waypoint Commands**
- /waypoint add <name> - Add a waypoint at your current coordinates.
- /waypoint remove <name> - Remove a waypoint by name.
- /waypoint list - List all your waypoints.

### **🛡️ Admin & Moderation Commands**
- /rank set <player> <rank> - Set a player's rank (player, king, admin).
- /rank get <player> - View a player's current rank.
- /rank remove <player> - Reset a player's rank back to player.
- /nick <player> <nickname> - Set a player's custom nickname (supports formatting and color codes using & or §).
- /nick <player> off or /nick <player> reset - Remove a custom nickname.
